home: Tap the big card for the full dashboard. Tap the bell for alerts and the round + to add anything.
rentals: Tap a rental to see what is owed and to record a payment. Chips filter the list and the sliders button sorts it. Full list shows every column, like the computer.
bookings: A booking becomes a rental when the car goes out. A red alert means a pickup is close.
vehicles: Tap a car for its photo, history and rate. Use Exit instead of delete so old records stay correct.
drivers: Tap a driver to see allowance and the car they are assigned to.
clients: Search before you add. If the name or phone is already here, the app tells you so nobody is entered twice.
payments: Money in is what clients pay you. Money out is what you spend. Both are recorded where the computer keeps them.
expenses: Pick the type and the car. Fuel is kept in the Fuel section so the Ola balance stays right.
fuel: A fill tagged Ola draws the Ola balance down. A fill tagged Outside is paid in cash. Tag every fill so the balance is right.
coop: Each line is a coop rental. Add one with the + button and the totals follow.
subhire: These are cars you borrowed to finish a rental. Mark paid when the owner is paid.
calendar: Tap a day to see which cars are free. Coloured lines are cars. A red dot is a public holiday. Tap + Book to reserve a car.
reports: Choose Day, Week, Month or Year, then use the arrows to move through time. Tap a car chip to see one car.
performance: See what each car earned after fuel and costs. Switch to Full list for the table the computer shows.
pilot: Tap a month to open its figures. These are the same numbers as the computer overview.
audit: This lists everything missing for 100% record fluency. Work down the list and each item leaves when it is fixed.
connect: Be on the same Wi-Fi as the office computer, then tap Sync now. Your new records go to the desktop and are backed up.
review: Items the phone held aside instead of guessing. Open one, fix it, then tap I have looked.
files: Back up now keeps a safety copy on the phone. Export saves a table as a CSV file.
deskdash: The same cards as the computer. Tap a card to see its records.
overdue: When a client pays, tap Record payment on their row. A part payment is fine. The balance stays here until it is cleared.
alerts: Red items are urgent. Tap an item to go straight to where you fix it.
notifs: Tap one to open it. The bell on Home shows how many are unread.
f-form: Fields with a star are needed. Fields with an arrow open your own list, so names are never typed twice.
f-pay: Money in is what a client pays you. Money out is what you spend. The questions change to match.
f-od: Check the amount, then save. You can pay part of what is owed. The balance stays on the overdue list.
detail: Tap Record payment when the client pays. Edit changes the record. The balance updates straight away.
settings: Display size changes text and spacing. Tap targets always stay at least 48 px.
sw-main: Swipe left to go on to Rentals, Calendar and Menu. Swipe right to come back. On Home, swipe right for the full dashboard.
sw-back: Swipe from left to right on any page to close it. The back arrow does the same.

tour.b: Tap this big card to open the full dashboard, the same cards as on the computer.
The bell shows what needs you: late cars, unpaid rentals, low fuel.
Tap + to add a rental, payment, booking, expense or fuel.
The Menu holds vehicles, fuel, reports and File & backup.
You will see one small tip the first time you open each screen. Turn tips off any time in Settings.
